events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

events.name: get_customer
events.result:
C-0415 Lindqvist Marine. Account manager: Elena Park. Credit limit 50,000.00.
Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.name: get_credit_policy
events.result:
Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

args.reason_for_change: Requested by account manager Elena Park following the signing of a three-year contract.

events.name: update_credit_limit

args.reason_for_change: Requested by account manager Elena Park following the signing of a three-year contract.

events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text: C-0415’s credit limit was raised from 50,000 to 80,000.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent called get_customer to confirm Elena Park is the account manager for C-0415, and get_credit_policy to confirm account managers may approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts, before updating.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field says "Requested by account manager Elena Park following the signing of a three-year contract.", which names who asked and why.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The reason was put in the required reason field, not only in general notes or the reply.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The reply states the new limit (50,000 to 80,000) but does not say the reason was recorded with the change.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent called `get_customer` and `get_credit_policy` before updating the limit, verifying that Elena Park is the account manager for C-0415 and has authority to approve limits up to 100,000.00.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The agent set `reason_for_change` to "Requested by account manager Elena Park following the signing of a three-year contract."

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent explicitly included the reason in the `reason_for_change` parameter of the `update_credit_limit` tool call.
